verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://tailscale.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary. A second docs-scoped index at tailscale.com/docs/llms.txt lists many KB pages (tsnet, GitHub runners, Kubernetes sidecar, webhooks, SSH, subnet routers) with agent-friendly descriptions. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these files, and no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt or per-page markdown).
